snippet.title: TCG Card Shop Simulator - Release Date Announcement | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018739

TCG Card Shop Simulator Arrives on PlayStation on September 15th! Trade cards, expand, customize, and decorate your unique card shop, and celebrate the wonderful world of TCG enthusiasts. 

Play against your customers in high stakes tournaments and prove your passion and skill to the TCG Community.

Pre-Order Now for Unique Items and Startup Investment!

#ps5 #ps5games
